## Checklist

- [ ] The repository is public and has `manifest.json` at its root.
- [ ] The app installs and runs with **Import app** in Chrysalis.
- [ ] The description says what the app does, plainly.
- [ ] `added` is today's date and the entry is at the end of the list.
- [ ] If the app's plugins use the network, the README says which hosts and why.
